A1_dynamic_partner.latent: L_t in {0,1}, one state per slice
A1_dynamic_partner.partner_emission: frozen v35.partner_channel_probability on the typed remaining channel
A1_dynamic_partner.contact_emission: frozen v35.contact_probability, marginalized jointly over L_t and the existing contact-response parameter
A1_dynamic_partner.factor_placement: A forward factor over (rho,L_t,theta_contact) replaces only the frozen adapter's static partner-trait mixture for partner/contact forecasts; it has no mode/context edge.

A2_exogenous_danger.latent: D_t in {0,1}, one exogenous world-state bit per slice
A2_exogenous_danger.temporal_process: candidate-common independent world-state draws; no stratum label enters inference
A2_exogenous_danger.identity_factor: D_t=0 uses frozen v35 root emission; D_t=1 uses the same atomic low root-signal row (0.14 for identity token 1), preventing exogenous danger from being forced into a mode-to-root edge
A2_exogenous_danger.outcome_factor: D_t=0 uses frozen v35 outcome prediction; D_t=1 uses the same atomic high-danger outcome row (0.86 for adverse outcome), with do(action) retained as an intervention and never scored
A2_exogenous_danger.factor_placement: D_t is marginalized inside the identity/outcome predictive factor and competes with mode-generated explanations; it has no partner/context edge.

forbidden: new coupling between partner and mode/context machinery
new danger parameter or stratum-specific danger prior
seed-based tuning toward the registered prediction
